'''Loading bay 372''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City's]] [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]]. [[Odea Aurora]] usually sold her wares to tourists at the back of loading bay 372.
